items.title: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE) - StyleSmuggler
items.summary: An unauthenticated remote code execution (RCE) zero-day vulnerability, dubbed "StyleSmuggler," was actively exploited in Magento Open Source and Adobe Commerce. Adobe released an emergency hotfix (APSB26-146) for this critical flaw (CVSS 10.0) on September 7, 2026.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover and other vulnerabilities
items.summary: Adobe released security updates (APSB26-92) that address seven vulnerabilities, including a critical unauthenticated customer account takeover with a CVSS score of 9.1. These updates also resolve other security feature bypass and privilege escalation bugs.

items.title: Remote Code Execution (RCE) via Unrestricted File Upload
items.summary: This is a remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability in Adobe Commerce caused by unrestricted file upload with dangerous types. Attackers can exploit this flaw to inject malicious scripts and achieve arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw (CVE-2026-53787) in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated PHP Object Injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability (CVE-2026-45247) in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a popular Magento extension. This flaw allows remote code execution via a crafted CacheWarmer cookie.
